designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system delivers an executive-grade, analytically rigorous environment for candidate screening and interview intelligence. Blending the structural restraint of modern developer utilities with the elevated typographic poise of editorial publishing, the aesthetic rejects the flashy, speculative tropes of generative AI (no bright purple gradients, glassmorphism, or synthetic glowing badges). Instead, it projects legal-grade accountability, institutional trust, and calm authority.

The system targets senior talent partners, hiring executives, and technical bar-raisers. Every interface interaction evokes clarity, precision, and verifiability. The visual philosophy couples razor-sharp layout architecture with meticulous information density, making complex talent pipelines and multimodal interview transcripts effortless to audit.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is built upon an adjustable 12-column grid balanced by rigid structural boundaries. Content density remains high without feeling compressed through strict horizontal rhythm and standardized cell heights.

- **Grid Architecture**: 12-column fluid structure paired with an immutable 280px left-hand intelligence navigation rail and an optional 380px contextual evidence drawer on the right.
- **Desktop (>= 1280px)**: 24px column gutters with 40px outer canvas margins. Multi-column transcript-to-scorecard validation splits.
- **Tablet (768px - 1279px)**: 16px column gutters with 24px outer margins. Collapses secondary audit drawers into overlay sheets.
- **Mobile (< 768px)**: 4-column flow with 16px margins. Evidence cards stack directly below interview summaries.
- **Vertical Rhythm**: Spacing scales strictly using 4px and 8px base units. Interactive table rows are locked to 40px (compact) and 56px (editorial reading) heights to eliminate visual jitter.

## Elevation & Depth

This design system deliberately eschews heavy blur radii, multi-stop drop shadows, and dramatic depth illusions. Depth is communicated strictly via **planar layering** and **optical hairline containment**:

- **Layer 0 (Canvas Base)**: `#FBFBFB` – Underlying canvas.
- **Layer 1 (Card & Module Surfaces)**: Pure `#FFFFFF`, bound by a crisp 1px border of `rgba(113, 105, 105, 0.20)`.
- **Layer 2 (Contextual Popovers & Overlays)**: `#FFFFFF` encased in a dual-border technique: an inner 1px border of `rgba(113, 105, 105, 0.25)` complemented by an ultra-diffused, shadowless ambient penumbra: `0 1px 3px rgba(15, 15, 15, 0.04), 0 8px 24px rgba(15, 15, 15, 0.03)`.
- **Active Structural Hierarchy**: Hover states and active selections never lift along the Z-axis. Instead, they shift planar tinting (e.g., `#F4F4F3`) or darken their bounding hairlines from `rgba(113, 105, 105, 0.2)` to `#0F0F0F`.

## Components

### 1. Buttons
- **Primary**: Solid `#0F0F0F` fill with `#FBFBFB` text. No drop shadow. Hover shifts to `#2D2E2E`. Active scale down to 0.99.
- **Secondary / Outline**: `#FFFFFF` background with 1px border of `rgba(113, 105, 105, 0.25)` and `#0F0F0F` text. Hover transitions background to `#F5F5F4`.
- **Ghost**: Transparent fill, `#2D2E2E` text. Hover yields `#EFEFEF` at 8px radius.
- **Audit / Trace Trigger**: Monospace text (`JetBrains Mono`, 11px), 1px dashed border `rgba(113, 105, 105, 0.4)`. Used strictly when clicking opens verification data.

### 2. Form Inputs & Selectors
- **Text Inputs**: Crisp `#FFFFFF` surface with 1px `rgba(113, 105, 105, 0.25)` perimeter. Text in `Geist`, 13px. Focus replaces border with 1px `#0F0F0F` outline and an outer 2px halo of `rgba(188, 171, 174, 0.35)` (Lilac Ash).
- **Checkboxes & Radios**: 16px square/circle with 1px stroke. Checked state is solid `#0F0F0F` housing a white checkmark.

### 3. Responsible AI Badges & Chips
These components discard neon, glowing, or gradient stylings in favor of disciplined evidentiary markers:
- **`[AI INSIGHT]`**: `#2D2E2E` text on `#F0EFEF` tag; `JetBrains Mono` uppercase 10px; hairline border in `rgba(113, 105, 105, 0.2)`.
- **`[SOURCE: TRANSCRIPT §4.2]`**: `#344054` on `#F2F4F7`; clickable indicator linking directly to video/audio timestamp.
- **`[VALIDATION NEEDED]`**: `#7C5329` text on `#FBF6F0`; signals ambiguity or conflicting candidate claims requiring human evaluation.
- **`[VERIFIED EVIDENCE]`**: `#2B4C3F` text on `#F0F4F2`; anchored to verified repository commits, employment records, or code execution tests.

### 4. Cards & Data Tables
- **Analytical Card**: Flat white background, 12px radius, enclosed in a 1px `rgba(113, 105, 105, 0.2)` border. Headers feature a mono subtitle eyebrow, a 17px Geist medium heading, and a discrete hairline separator running edge-to-edge.
- **Data Table**: Borderless outer edges with alternating subtle rows or pure white rows delineated by hairline bottom borders (`rgba(113, 105, 105, 0.15)`). Monospace numbers right-aligned with tabular numerals enabled (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`).

### 5. Candidate Transcript & Evidence Split-Pane
- Left pane displays the transcript in `Geist` with inline speaker tags (`JetBrains Mono`).
- Critical interview claims display an unobtrusive lilac-ash underline (`#BCABAE`). Hovering surfaces an analytical sidebar displaying extracted behavioral metrics, technical verification status, and timestamp validation without obscuring contextual reading flow.

- **Structural Neutral (`#716969`)**: Dim grey leveraged at varying opacities for hairline borders (`rgba(113, 105, 105, 0.2)`), table grids, and de-emphasized metadata labels.
- **Lilac Ash (`#BCABAE`)**: Muted, sophisticated neutral-tint accent. Applied sparingly for subtle active indicator rings, timeline scrubbing pins, and grounded analytical callouts.

- **Positive / Verified**: `#2B4C3F` (Deep Forest) on `#F0F4F2` (Whisper Pine)
- **Attention / Validation Needed**: `#7C5329` (Umber Ochre) on `#FBF6F0` (Muted Sand)
- **Citation / Traceability**: `#344054` (Iron Blue) on `#F2F4F7` (Pale Slate)

2. **Deterministic Monospace (`JetBrains Mono`)**: Powers the systemic evidence layer. Any data derived from an algorithm, time-stamped video transcript, citation anchor, candidate commit log, or model audit trail must be rendered in `JetBrains Mono`.
